title: Sisters on the river
text: My sister and I were in Seville celebrating my 70th birthday, and booked an early morning kayaking trip. Domingo responded to our request for a double kayak, as my sister has not kayaked before. On arrival, the instructions and guidance were efficiently communicated, and we soon paddling across the river to commence our adventure. The river was quiet at this early time, and we thoroughly enjoyed by our time on the river. Very good value. Highly recommend.
